name: Glass-Cast Heart
oracle_text:
Whenever one or more Vampires you control attack, create a Blood token. (It's an artifact with "{1}, {T}, Discard a card, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
{B}, {T}, Pay 1 life: Create a 1/1 white and black Vampire creature token with lifelink.
{B}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact and thirteen Blood tokens: Each opponent loses 13 life and you gain 13 life.
blocked_sentences: {B}{B}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact and thirteen Blood tokens: Each opponent loses 13 life and you gain 13 life.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that sacrifices several groups of permanents each matching its own selector and count -- here the source itself (self_only, count 1) AND thirteen Blood tokens (subtypes Blood, is_token, count 13) -- payable only when every part can be met; e.g. `sacrifice` accepting a list of selectors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `sacrifice` cost key takes one selector plus `count` (costs.py `_sacrifice_pool`), and there is no separate sacrifice-self cost key; `count: 14` with `any_of` [self_only, Blood] would accept fourteen Blood tokens while keeping the artifact, and sacrificing the source in the effects moves part of the payment to resolution. The other two lines are expressible (`you_attack` with an `exists` on `attackers` subtypes Vampire creating `blood_token`; a `{B}`+tap+pay_life cost creating `vampire_1_1_wb_lifelink`).
